import sys

    if not data:
        return

    n, m = data[0], data[1]
    adj = [0] * n

    idx = 2
    for _ in range(m):
        x = data[idx] - 1
        y = data[idx + 1] - 1
        idx += 2
        adj[x] |= 1 << y
        adj[y] |= 1 << x

    full = 1 << n
    dp = [0] * full
    dp[0] = 1

    for mask in range(1, full):
        lsb = mask & -mask
        v = lsb.bit_length() - 1
        rest = mask ^ lsb
        dp[mask] = dp[rest] + dp[rest & ~adj[v]]

    print(dp[full - 1] - 1)
